text: 中国建筑公告，公司于2026年7月20日收到控股股东中建集团通知，中建集团拟自本公告披露之日起12个月内通过上海证券交易所交易系统以集中竞价交易方式增持公司A股股份，增持总金额不低于人民币5亿元，不超过人民币10亿元。
text_en: China State Construction announced that on July 20, 2026, it received notice from controlling shareholder CSCEC Group, which plans to increase its A-share holdings via centralized bidding on the Shanghai Stock Exchange within 12 months from the disclosure date, with total amount between 500 million yuan and 1 billion yuan.
